# Arch Design System

## What this is
A React component library with 51 components, a three-layer token system, and an MCP server for AI agent consumption. Built for teams that want accessible, themeable UI primitives with first-class agent support.

## MCP Server
npx @arch-ui/mcp-server
Tools: get_component, find_component, list_components, get_token, list_tokens, get_pattern, validate_usage, get_token_alias_chain, list_deprecated

## Token architecture
Three layers: primitive (raw values) → semantic (intent-based, what brands override) → component (per-component usage). All values are CSS custom properties.

## Customisation
Import @arch-ui/tokens/css, then @arch-ui/tokens/brand-template. Override semantic tokens in brand-template to apply your brand. All components update automatically.

## RTL support
Set dir="rtl" on the html element. All components use CSS logical properties and respond automatically.

## Dark mode
Set data-theme="dark" on the html element or any container.

## Accessibility
All components target WCAG 2.1 AA. Every interactive component has keyboard and screen reader support.

## Components — stable
Accordion — A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that expand or collapse associated content panels.
Alert — An inline feedback message for communicating status or important information.
Avatar — Displays a user's profile image with an initials fallback.
AvatarGroup — Wraps multiple Avatar components in a horizontal stack with overlap and overflow count.
Badge — An inline label for status, count, or categorical information.
Banner — A full-width top-of-page announcement bar.
Box — Generic container with token-based styling props.
Breadcrumbs — An ordered list of links showing the user's location in a hierarchy.
Button — A polymorphic button supporting multiple variants, sizes, and loading state.
Card — A surface container for grouping related content with optional clickability.
Checkbox — A checkbox input with checked, indeterminate, disabled, and error states.
CheckboxGroup — A fieldset container for grouping Checkbox components.
Code — Inline code snippets or block-level code samples.
Display — Large display text for hero sections and visual emphasis.
Divider — A visual separator with optional inline label.
Drawer — A panel that slides in from a configurable side of the screen.
FileUpload — A drag-and-drop file upload zone with size validation.
FocusTrap — Constrains keyboard Tab cycling within a container.
FormControl — Connects label, input, helper text, and error message via ARIA context.
Grid — CSS Grid wrapper with token-based gap and responsive columns.
Heading — Semantic h1-h6 with independent typographic sizing.
IconButton — An icon-only button requiring aria-label.
Inline — Horizontal flex layout with token-based gap.
Input — A single-line text input with leading/trailing slots and three sizes.
Label — UI text for interactive elements.
Link — Anchor element with token-based color variants and external link handling.
List — Semantic list components for bullet, numbered, and description lists.
Modal — A full-overlay dialog with scroll lock, focus trap, and configurable size.
Overlay — A fixed-position semi-transparent backdrop.
Pagination — Page number buttons with previous/next controls and ellipsis truncation.
Paragraph — Body text optimised for readability.
Popover — An interactive overlay panel triggered by click.
Portal — Renders children into a DOM node outside the React tree.
ProgressBar — A linear progress indicator for determinate and indeterminate operations.
ProgressSteps — A step indicator for multi-step flows.
Radio — A radio input with custom-styled visual overlay.
RadioGroup — A fieldset container for Radio components with arrow key navigation.
Select — A native select element styled consistently with Input.
Skeleton — A shimmer placeholder shown while content loads.
SkipNav — Skip-to-main-content link for keyboard accessibility.
Slider — A range slider rendered as a native input[type=range].
Spinner — A circular loading indicator respecting prefers-reduced-motion.
Stack — Vertical flex layout with token-based gap.
Table — A semantic HTML table with striped rows, bordered cells, and size presets.
Tabs — Horizontal and vertical tabs with line and enclosed variants.
Tag — A removable categorisation label with optional icon.
Textarea — A multi-line text input with auto-resize mode.
Toast — A transient notification system with imperative useToast hook.
Toggle — A binary on/off switch with role='switch'.
Tooltip — Non-interactive supplementary content shown on hover and focus.
VisuallyHidden — Hides content visually while keeping it accessible to screen readers.

## Components — beta
(none)

## Components — deprecated
(none)

## Foundations
Tokens, Grid, Typography, Color, Spacing, Motion, Icons, Accessibility, RTL

## Do not
- Do not use primitive tokens directly in components or application code — use semantic tokens
- Do not import from a component's internal folder — import from the package root
- Do not override component tokens directly in application CSS — override semantic tokens instead
